title: Neural circuit mechanisms underlying context-specific halting in Drosophila.
source_locator: Fig. 2b,e,h,k (P9 alone, black traces); Supplementary Table 1 row Fig. 2 P9
mapping_basis: Paper names the neuron P9 (DNp09) and its Supplementary Table 3 gives MANC type DNp09; the kit lists DNp09 also as a hemibrain name for DNp71 and the driver VT023490;R38F04 as AMBIGUOUS DNp09/DNp71, so medium.
stimulation: red light (630 nm) pulsed 50 Hz, 5 ms pulses, 0.038 mW/mm2 at arena surface, 10 s ON / 50 s OFF x5
sensory_condition: free-walking in 44 mm bowl arena, IR backlight, dim green light
notes: P9-alone is the reference genotype in walk+halt coactivation; Fig. 2b,e show translational velocity rising from ~6 to ~13 mm/s and angular velocity rising at light onset. Centroid tracking only (FlyTracker), no leg tracking, so legs coded yes per the forward-walking convention at medium confidence. Coactivation genotypes (P9+BB/FG/BRK) not recorded as separate records. The paper's own connectome model simulates P9 activation (Fig. 3a-d).

title: Neural circuit mechanisms underlying context-specific halting in Drosophila.
source_locator: Fig. 2a,d,g,j (MDN alone, black traces); Extended Data Fig. 4b; Methods 'Data analysis'
quote: MDN (moonwalker descending neuron) that drives backward walking31
mapping_basis: MDN is a MANC type name; paper's Supplementary Table 3 gives MANC type MDN.
stimulation: red light (630 nm) pulsed 50 Hz, 5 ms pulses, 0.038 mW/mm2 at arena surface, 10 s ON / 50 s OFF x5
notes: Fig. 2a: forward velocity drops from ~10 mm/s to negative (backward) at light onset; Methods: after ~2 s of continuous MDN stimulation flies switch between backward and forward bouts. effect_on_walking 'slows' stands for the forward velocity reversing to backward walking. Centroid tracking only. Supplementary Table 1 writes the MDN genotype with the AD/DBD hemidrivers the other way round (VT044845-ZpGDBD; VT050660-p65ADZp) compared with Supplementary Table 2.

title: Neural circuit mechanisms underlying context-specific halting in Drosophila.

mapping_basis: MDN is a MANC type name; paper's Supplementary Table 3 gives MANC type MDN.

title: Neural circuit mechanisms underlying context-specific halting in Drosophila.
quote: Optogenetically activating oDN1 and BDN2 drove walking initiation, with BDN2 showing a much stronger phenotype (Fig. 3j).
mapping_basis: synonyms.csv maps oDN1 (literature, Sapkal 2024) to exactly one MANC type, DNg97; the driver line is listed for DNg97 in driver_lines.csv. The paper's own Supplementary Table 3 instead gives MANC type DNxl054 (noted).
stimulation: red light 0.04 mW/mm2 pulsed at 100 Hz, 10 s ON / 50 s OFF x5
sensory_condition: powdered (dust-induced grooming), stationary grooming flies in bowl arena
notes: Fig. 3j: translational velocity of grooming flies rises above control (**). The rise is modest (median <1 mm/s) and is measured by centroid tracking, so medium confidence. The paper describes the split as made 'to specifically target these neurons'. The paper's own model reports simulated oDN1 firing rates (Fig. 3, Fig. 5c).

title: Neural circuit mechanisms underlying context-specific halting in Drosophila.

title: Neural circuit mechanisms underlying context-specific halting in Drosophila.

title: Neural circuit mechanisms underlying context-specific halting in Drosophila.
